T2M.name: Air temperature
T2M.definition: Average air temperature 2 metres above the ground.
T2M.caution: Model-based estimate (MERRA-2 reanalysis) for one grid cell of about 50 km. Reliable for temperature.

PRECTOTCORR.name: Rain and snowfall
PRECTOTCORR.definition: Average precipitation per day, rain and melted snow together.
PRECTOTCORR.caution: Model-based estimate (MERRA-2). Less reliable for precipitation than for temperature; treat as indicative.

GWETROOT.name: Root-zone soil wetness
GWETROOT.definition: How wet the soil is where plant roots grow: 0 is bone dry, 1 is saturated.
GWETROOT.caution: Model-based estimate (MERRA-2). Less reliable than temperature.

NO2.name: Nitrogen dioxide (air pollution)
NO2.definition: A gas from traffic, power plants and industry, measured from space as the amount in the lower atmosphere above the city.
NO2.caution: Satellite measurement (OMI). Cloudy days are missing, so monthly averages use the clear days only.

IMERG.name: Rain and snowfall (satellite)
IMERG.definition: Precipitation estimated from satellites and rain gauges.
IMERG.caution: Satellite and gauge blend (GPM IMERG), averaged over a region.

SOIL10.name: Topsoil moisture
SOIL10.definition: Water held in the top 10 cm of soil.
SOIL10.caution: Land-model estimate (GLDAS Noah), averaged over a region.

vancouver:PRECTOTCORR.sentence: Rain and snowfall in Vancouver shows no clear direction over 45 years (1981 to 2025).

vancouver:GWETROOT.sentence: Root-zone soil wetness in Vancouver shows no clear direction over 45 years (1981 to 2025).

cases.title: The Arctic is warming
cases.question: Is Inuvik, in Canada's Arctic, really getting warmer?
cases.note: A clear case. Open Hidden Seasons to see which months carry the warming.

cases.title: Two cities, opposite air
cases.question: Did air pollution go the same way in Los Angeles and Dhaka?
cases.note: Same gas, same satellite, opposite directions.

cases.title: Same warming, opposite water
cases.question: Inuvik and Phoenix are warming at the same rate. Is their soil changing the same way?
cases.note: The challenge's central point: one driver, opposite local results. Phoenix's drying is not yet confirmed, and the app says so.

cases.title: The hidden turn
cases.question: Is Beijing's air pollution rising or falling?
cases.note: The answer depends on which years you look at.

cases.title: Not enough evidence
cases.question: Is Inuvik getting more rain and snow?
cases.note: It looks like a trend. The Evidence Clock says how long until we can be sure.

cases.title: Home case: Vancouver
cases.question: Is Vancouver warming?
cases.note: A local case, with a slower rate than the Arctic.

cases.title: The shifting seasons
cases.question: Is Vancouver's rainfall changing?
cases.note: The yearly answer is no. The monthly answer is more interesting.
